components.name: List
components.element:
<List filters={[
 <TextInput source="id" alwaysOn/>,
 <Component schema="schema" name="ParseInput" component={TextInput} source="title" parse={value => `Like('%${value}%')`}/>,
 <Component schema="schema" name="ParseInput" component={SelectInput} source="tags" parse={value => `{name: '${value}'}`} choices={settings.page.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: tag}))}/>
]} exporter={false}>
 <Datagrid rowClick={false}>
  <FunctionField source="id" render={({id}) =>
   <Link to={`/${id}`}>{id}</Link>
  }/>
  <TextField source="title"/>
  <ArrayField source="tags">
   <SingleFieldList linkType={false}>
    <ChipField source="name" size="small"/>
   </SingleFieldList>
  </ArrayField>
  <EditButton/>
 </Datagrid>
</List>

components.name: Create
components.element:
<Create>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label="General">
   <TextInput source="id" validate={[required()]}/>
   <TextInput source="title"/>
   <Component schema="schema" name="CodeInput" source="body"/>
   <ImageInput multiple accept={{'image/*': []}} source="@files.body">
    <Component schema="page" name="ImageInput"/>
   </ImageInput>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Tags">
   <ArrayInput source="tags" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator inline getItemLabel={() => ''}>
     <SelectInput source="name" choices={settings.page.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: tag}))} validate={[required()]}/>
     <DateTimeInput source="start"/>
     <DateTimeInput source="end"/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Create>

components.name: Edit
components.element:
<Edit>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label="General">
   <Labeled source="userId">
    <TextField source="userId"/>
   </Labeled>
   <Labeled source="date">
    <DateField showTime source="date"/>
   </Labeled>
   <TextInput source="title"/>
   <Component schema="schema" name="CodeInput" source="body"/>
   <ImageInput multiple accept={{'image/*': []}} source="@files.body">
    <Component schema="page" name="ImageInput"/>
   </ImageInput>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Tags">
   <ArrayInput source="tags" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator inline getItemLabel={() => ''}>
     <SelectInput source="name" choices={settings.page.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: tag}))} validate={[required()]}/>
     <DateTimeInput source="start"/>
     <DateTimeInput source="end"/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Edit>

components.name: One
components.element:
<Content resource="page" name="one" id={props.id}>
 {({title, code}) =>
  (() => <Parser code={code}/>)(title && (document.title = title))
 }
</Content>

components.name: Menu
components.element:
<Content resource="page" name="menu">
 {content =>
  <List>
   {content.map(({id, title}) =>
    <ListItem key={id}>
      <ListItemButton component={Link} to={`/${id}`}>
        <ListItemText primary={title}/>
      </ListItemButton>
    </ListItem>
   )}
  </List>
 }
</Content>

components.name: ImageInput
components.element: {((value, {setValue}) => setValue('body', (value ? value : '') + ``)}/>)(useWatch({name: 'body'}), useFormContext())}
